newsitem.title: THAILAND: TABLE-Thai June wholesale prices fall yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Thai June wholesale prices fall yr/yr.

text.p: The Thai wholesale price index (WPI) fell 1.4 percent year-on-year in June against a 0.1 percent increase in the previous month, the Commerce Ministry said on Tuesday.
The ministry said wholesale prices fell 1.2 percent in June from May against a 0.3 percent rise month-on-month rise in the previous month.
The ministry said the 1985-based index fell to 154.4 in June from its 156.6 level in June 1996.
